children: Phase II results for CUE-221 in CSU showed robust, dose-responsive efficacy, with high-dose CUE-221 achieving sustained complete resolution of hives and a statistically significant advantage over omalizumab at 12 weeks off drug. The dual mechanism of action supports potential for disease modification. Plans for phase II-B/III in CSU and phase II in food allergy are underway.
